runtimeRequirements: Bare /loop opens a typed editor for goal [focus] or workflow <runId> [focus]; invalid input is preserved and the editor reopens with a warning
Cancelling bare /loop creates no continuation artifact and triggers no model turn
/loop status reports idle/manual/blocked based on goal and workflow state
/loop once goal coordinates with the existing /goal continue bounded-artifact contract
/loop once workflow <runId> uses persisted workflow run metadata when present; otherwise fails closed with a clear reason
Command-visible continuation output shows metadata/path and omits full prompt bodies from the widget
start and until schedule hidden follow-up turns through Pi sendMessage and agent_settled
each session has one persisted loop state with default hard stops of 20 iterations and 30 minutes
until uses a model-evaluated condition and instructs the model to call loop stop when satisfied
transport, missing-source, duration, and iteration failures stop the loop explicitly
